Novelty: 5
Justification: The solution is truly groundbreaking in its framing. Moving beyond standard compliance-migration playbooks, it introduces highly original strategic concepts, such as the 5-tier "sovereignty ladder" (converting a cost shock into a revenue ladder), the "region factory" concept, and the explicit treatment of the transition as a "trust negotiation conducted in ~15 different political languages." The insight that AI inference will be the primary cause of feature disparity in 2026 is a remarkably prescient and non-obvious observation.

Usefulness: 5
Justification: The strategy is exceptionally ready to implement. It provides concrete, actionable mechanisms such as the Feature Parity SLA with service credits, the "decouple migration from renewal" rule to avoid handing leverage to competitors, and the pre-approved "save playbook" for churn defense. The per-account migration contract outline and the specific cadence timeline (T-12 to T+30) give program managers an immediate, operational blueprint to execute against.

Flexibility: 5
Justification: The solution is highly versatile, rejecting one-track thinking. It accommodates diverse customer needs through the tiered product ladder (allowing customers to self-select their required rung) and adapts to different regional constraints through the "single codebase, configuration-driven regionalization" engineering model. It also offers a segmented communication strategy that scales from named executive sponsors for top accounts to automated portals for the long tail.

Elaboration: 5
Justification: Exhaustively detailed. The solution leaves no gap between high-level strategy and on-the-ground execution. It covers engineering (no-fork rules, definition-of-done gates), commercial strategy (absorbing Tier 1 costs, early-mover protection), migration execution (dry runs, freeze discipline), and metrics (execution, trust, value creation). The inclusion of a regional trust playbook table with specific "emphasize" and "avoid" instructions for 10 distinct global markets demonstrates incredible depth.

Cultural Sensitivity: 5
Justification: Universally appropriate and deeply culturally mindful. The solution explicitly recognizes that "localization is not automatically reassuring" in markets with low institutional trust and warns that asymmetric messaging will leak across borders. The regional trust playbooks accurately capture the nuances of different cultural lenses—from legal precision in Germany to consensus decision-making in Japan and national prestige in the Gulf. The directive to use local-national spokespeople because "the messenger's nationality is part of the message" shows a masterful grasp of global communication.
